batting.name: DA Warner
batting.dismissal: c SV Samson b SR Watson

batting.name: EJG Morgan
batting.dismissal: c SPD Smith b SR Watson

batting.name: AM Rahane
batting.dismissal: c NV Ojha b B Kumar

batting.name: SR Watson
batting.dismissal: c P Kumar b I Sharma

batting.name: KK Nair
batting.dismissal: c NV Ojha b MC Henriques

batting.name: DJ Hooda
batting.dismissal: c B Kumar b KV Sharma

batting.name: JP Faulkner
batting.dismissal: c RS Bopara b B Kumar

balls.text: a low full toss, flicked off the pads to square leg, just the single to end the innings
mis-timed towards long on for a single
in the blockhole, Ojha digs it out on to his boot and back to the bowler, Bopara had run a way out of his crease but Morris does the sensible thing and doesn't attempt a direct hit
a low full toss, Bopara gets under it and hits it flat towards Smith at long on, he jumps up in the air as the ball begins to bounce over his head and fields
that's going to be a wide, just outside the guide lines on the off side, Morris was trying to bowl it full and far away from the right-hander
flicked off the pads through the leg side
a low full toss, mis-timed on the leg side
full and wide outside off, Ojha cuts the ball hard towards deep backward point where Tambe mis-fields to allow the boundary. Tambe mis-judged the speed on the ball and couldn't get his body behind it
smashed hard back at the bowler and Faulkner can't get out of the way in time, he ducks and holds his right arm up for protection, he gets hit on the forearm but doesn't show any discomfort
swings across the line and is beaten outside off stump

full and wide outside off, this time Bopara moves towards the ball and drives hard, smashing it towards wide long off, Smith sprints to his left and slides but the ball bounces past him. Smith is unhappy with his effort and punches the ground
full and wide again, outside off, but just inside the wide line. The batsman flays at the ball but misses
a full toss outside off, driven to deep cover for a single
sprays that full and really wide outside off, the batsman doesn't even attempt to play a shot
the slower ball stops on Bopara who pushes it into the covers to keep strike
pulled towards deep backward square leg, Faulkner and Tambe give chase
he's gone now, caught at long-off! Morgan smashed it again, flat and hard. That ball was travelling quickly but the man on the boundary is Steven Smith and he takes it easily.
that's a monstrous hit! He moves towards the off side and drags a full ball from wide outside off, carting far over the wide long-on boundary. the 50 partnership comes up, Bopara has made 6
Morgan jumps out of his crease but has to lunge for the ball because it is wide outside off stump, he manges to hit it towards deep cover, where Binny fields
full ball outside off, Morgan is standing on middle and off, covering all three stumps, and he square drives to deep point
full and wide outside off stump, driven on the front foot to deep point
52 off 23 balls for Morgan, top innings this! He gets there by glancing a full ball off his pads past the fielder at short fine leg, poor line and length
Morgan skips out of his crease in a flash to a length delivery and hammers the ball with a flat bat, sending it over the bowler's head for six
width outside off stump and Morgan cuts late, placing the ball wide of the third man fielder so he has time to return for the second
short ball, Morgan was on the front foot and he tries to hook but gets beaten over his shoulder
that was driven fiercely off the front foot and Hooda fails at point, he doesn't get down low quickly enough and the ball scoots through his legs for four
Bopara does the sensible thing, giving Morgan the strike by punching to long on
Tambe's punishment is over. After three great overs, he's been hammered in his last. Morgan ends the spell by biffing the ball flat over the bowler's head and all the way into the sightscreen
right, Morgan is striking it superbly now. He leans forward to the googly and drives it with the turn into the gap on the cover boundary
driven on the front foot to long off, placed wide of the fielder so there is time for two
he's hit this perfectly, lunging on to the front foot, getting down low and slog sweeping the full ball far over deep midwicket
short and wide outside off, Morgan reaches for it and hits towards cover, not timed well
that's a juicy full toss and Morgan has missed it! He tried to pull off the front foot but got hit on the thigh

edged and four! Bopara decided not to leave this one, he went after a full and wide ball with a flowing drive. The edge flew thick and fast to Samson's right, he dived but only managed to get a bit of glove on it as it raced to the third man boundary. There was a slip in place too
he's let one go outside off! Took me by surprise there.
a slower one outside off, Morgan waits in his crease and cuts through cover point for a single
Bopara moves forward and pushes to mid off, he's running immediately, sprinting to beat the direct hit, which he does easily
reverse-swatting a fast bowler is not as easy as a spinner! The length is too full and the line too straight for the shot. Dhawan misses and Faulker rattles off stump
Morgan steps out of is crease, doesn't have room tow work with so he pushes the ball off his body towards long on
he gets into position quickly and reverse-swats a flat ball from around off stump and beats the fielder at short third man, no catching this
I thought Dhawan had top edged this but he hasn't! The ball sailed over the fielder at deep square leg for six! He slog swept that superbly to bring up his half-century
driven to long on off the front foot
that's really wide down leg side, the keeper tries well to connect
goes back and plays the ball off his pads through the leg side

Dhawan plays the reverse swat, chipping it over short third man. The ball begins to rush towards the third man boundary but Tambe sprints after it and dived superbly to save the four. Not bad at all for a 43-year old, will put some of the younger players to shame
Morgan charges Watson, getting under a full length ball and carting it over the long off boundary with a clean strike, Morgan looks to be coming good today
Morgan replies by driving a full and wide delivery to the cover boundary, he had lots of room to free his arms so he went after it and lofted the ball over the infield
the effort ball from Watson, dug in short with a lot of shoulder, it gets big on Morgan who had come forward and then turned his head and evaded the delivery
Dhawan backs away outside leg to make a lot of room, he then slaps the short of a length ball from around off stump to long off, just the single
Morgan steps out to a length ball again and drives it through point for a single to the fielder on the boundary
Dhawan steps out to a length ball and drives to long off
a full toss wide outside off stump, that would have been a wide had the batsman not reached out and hit it to deep cover
nudged off the pads towards short fine leg
steps out of his crease but maybe a bit too early because the bowler sees him and bowls down leg side, the batsman reaches for it and glances square
cut off the back foot towards deep point
Morgan tries to slog sweep and plays it to short fine leg
Dhawan plays the reverse paddle to a flat ball, hits it to short third man
pushed off the front foot towards point
fuller ball around off, gave it some air too, Dhawan drives to long off for one more
a full toss around off, which Morgan leans forward and drives along the ground to long off

Henriques moves too early, backing away towards leg to slog, Tambe sees him going and fires the ball flat, fast and straight, cramping the batsman for room. Henriques swings across the line and misses. Bowled.
Henriques steps out too, and towards leg, but ends up playing the ball back to Tambe
Dhawan steps out to take the ball on the full and then chips it towards long off, the ball gets to the fielder on the bounce
a slower ball, on a fuller length around off stump, he mis-times the drive and hits the ball into the ground near his feet
a length ball with width outside off, Henriques moves forward and drives on the up to long off
too short once again, Henriques pulls once again, once again Binny pursues from deep square leg but by the time he dives at deep midwicket the ball is past him and over the boundary
Dhawan steps forward and swings across the line, pulling firmly towards deep square leg
hit into the ground and the ball bounces over the bowler towards long on
short ball, Henriques stands tall in his crease and pulls the ball towards deep midwicket, Binny runs to his left from deep square leg but mis-times his dive and fails to prevent the boundary
in the blockhole on middle and leg, Henriques digs it out awkwardly and gets an edge towards short third man
dug out towards point from his crease
tossed up on leg stump, Dhawan gets down on one knee and mows the ball to the deep square leg boundary with a slog sweep, full swing of the arms
nudged off the pads towards long on for a single
Henriques tries to step out but mis-times it towards cover
Henriques steps out of his crease and moves towards leg to make room, Tambe follows him with a full ball, Henriques defends on the leg side
defended on the off side from the crease
Dhawan backs away outside leg to create room against a slightly fuller ball around off and then hammers it through cover with a flowing drive, he finds the gap on the boundary
beaten outside the off stump, that's a good ball. Kulkarni pitched it on a good length around off and angled it across the left-hander, beating Dhawan as he tries to drive on the up
a fuller delivery and closer to off stump, Dhawan tries to run it to third man but is beaten
Dhawan charges again but Kulkarni has sprayed it too wide outside off for a shot to be attempted
too short, a long hop, Dhawan winds up and unleashes a fearsome pull, blazing the ball flat and far towards deep midwicket, one bounce and over the boundary
good length around off stump, Dhawan stays in his crease and dabs the ball towards point
dragged down a bit short, Dhawan goes back and hits the ball towards long on
played on the leg side for a single, Tambe delivered that ball from way behind the crease
a leaping save by Rahane at cover, diving full length and pulling down the ball with his left hand after it was past him, Henriques had driven that so hard
played off the back foot towards point
moves forward this time and plays towards cover
flat and fast on middle and off, Henriques stays in his crease and defends on the off side
steered off the back foot but can't get it past the man at backward point
now he does find the gap, leaning into a full ball and driving it smoothly through covers, he can come back for a second before the fielder at deep point gets to the ball
and again, but the drive is straight to mid-off, Dhawan had moved forward to a full ball around off to play a fluent shot
good length around off, Dhawan moves forward and punches towards mid-off, he's middling the ball beautifully today
fuller length on a straighter line, leg and middle, Henriques tries to flick but does not make proper contact
that's a loosner, full and wide outside off stump, Henriques moves forward and slashes, flaying the ball through point for a boundary
strays on to the pads, Henriques moves across and glances behind square to score his first run
good length outside off stump and the ball stops on the batsman, Henriques began to push at it but then checked his shot, playing it into the covers
Watson falls to the pitch in his follow through, not very pretty, but the ball was good length around off. Henriques defends on the front foot

caught behind! Warner tries to make it three boundaries in a row in the point and third man region, so he goes back and cuts hard. This time the ball is not as short and the line is not as wide outside off, so he gets an edge that carries comfortably to the keeper
can't bowl there with no fielders at deep point, short and wide outside off, Warner carves it, high and far point point for four more
too wide from Watson, Warner waits for it in his crease as the ball angles across him and opens the face to find the gap between fielders at short third man and backward point
Warner pushes the ball with soft hands - relatively speaking - towards mid-off and charges through for a single
that's a shocker from Morris, a full toss so wide down leg side that the keeper had no chance of even getting close to that. The ball slipped out of Morris' hands. Sweaty fingers?
played into the off side

finally Warner gets some width from Morris and he cashes in, the ball is short and wide and Warner biffs it with a horizontal bat between the bowler and mid-on. Warner grimaces after the shot, he's feeling his back. A concern for Sunrisers ... and Australia
good length around off stump, Warner stays in his crease and cuts late, can't get the ball past backward point
good length on middle stump, Warner stays back and plays a short-arm swat through square leg
driven towards mid-off on the front foot
superb drive from Dhawan, barely moves his feet as he threads a length ball from just outside off through the covers, hit that on the up and timed it perfectly
there's a deep point in place and he runs to his right to field a firm drive from Warner, the ball was full and outside off stump
Warner drives into the covers but does not time it well
short of a length on the hips, Dhawan tucks it off his back foot through square
short and wide outside off, Dhawan frees his arms and cuts, he gets a thick outside edge that flies wide of the only slip - Watson - and speeds to the third man boundary
too wide outside off and Kulkarni is lucky to escape punishment there, Dhawan's cover drive went towards point
Morris is getting the new ball to rise off this pitch, Warner cuts off the back foot but can't beat point
banged in short and well directed too, at Warner's body, Warner attacks the ball with a pull but the ball hits high on the bat and goes towards square leg
defended on the back foot towards cover, no room to work with for Warner
good length on leg and middle stump, tucks Warner up and he gets hit on the thigh as he tries to work the ball square
short of a length outside off stump, cut hard into the ground and the ball goes over point, there's a fielder in the deep
a length ball on the pads, poor line when fine leg is in the circle, Dhawan glances and beats the fielder and collects his second boundary
goes back in a flash this time and cuts hard with tremendous bat speed, the ball flies to Rahane's left at point and once it beats the dive it speeds to the boundary
steps out of his crease to a wider ball and frees his arms, driving the ball flat and hard over extra cover for four more
Warner moves forward and drives a full ball firmly towards mid off
steps out of his crease this time to tap the ball towards midwicket and turn the strike over
on the fuller side outside off, enough width for Dhawan to stride forward and drive the ball along the ground to the cover boundary with such grace
good length and line into the left-hand batsman from round the wicket - off and middle stump - Dhawan defends on the front foot
the slower one outside off stump, Morris hits it towards point, Sunrisers win by seven runs.
Morris hammers the full ball straight at hard, but Sunrisers will have watched in glee as it bounces once and then twice before going over the boundary
in the blockhole, Morris flicks but gets an inside edge towards short fine leg where Ishant dives to save the boundary
a full toss, Binny is on the front foot again and hits the ball to long on, he needs to be waiting in his crease for these full toss balls, he's rushing at them instead
that's really wide outside off and Morris reaches for it and hits it to deep cover, Bhuvneshwar is denying Morris the space to hit on the leg side
a low full toss, Binny meets it on the front foot and drives hard down the ground, just the single
full and straight again, Binny drives to long off, Morris won't have the strike for the start of the final over
nearly in the blockhole again, Morris can only hit it out towards long on, where Warner keeps them to a single
in the blockhole, and a slower ball too, Morris plays it towards deep midwicket and they rush back for the second to keep strike
three out of three! What is going on here! Praveen drops it short and Morris pulls fiercely, smashing it flat over deep square leg.
and again! This time it's far away from Morgan at deep midwicket. Morris gets under a full toss and hammers it with a tremendous heave across the line

what a shot that is from Morris! Picked up the length early and lofted it clean off his pads high and far over deep midwicket, Morgan dives superbly to try and catch it or parry it back into play but it evades him
the slower ball and Morris plays a chippy swat over square leg, falls well short of the deep fielders
Morris moves right across his stumps first ball and scoops over the head of the fielder at short fine leg

bowled him! Bhuvneshwar adjusts his line outside off stump, and the length isn't a full toss, it is good. Samson tries to drag it from outside off towards leg and gets an inside edge on to the stumps. Should Samson have batted high today? What's he doing at No. 8?
that's flat, has it gone far enough? It has! Samson waited in his crease again for a low full toss on the pads and swung it clean over the fielder at deep square leg

Samson shows Faulkner how it's done! The length was similar to the previous one but Samson stayed in his crease, using the depth and hammering it straight over the bowler's head, that cleared the sightscreen
the finisher's gone! Bhuvneshwar bowls a low full toss, Faulkner can't get under it properly and ends up lofting it flat and straight to Bopara on the long-on boundary. It's all over.
good length outside off, Faulkner hits it off the back foot towards cover
super slow from Bopara outside off, Faulkner gets an inside edge as he tries to hit on the off side
Samson moves across his stumps to scoop but ends up hitting it towards short fine leg, Faulkner sprints through
comes out of his crease too early to play on the leg side and is hit on the pad by a slower ball, it goes towards third man at gentle speed and they race for two
that's some sweet connection, picking a length ball off his pads and sending it over the deep midwicket boundary with a graceful swing of the bat
that was so slow that Samson got into position way too early and then didn't play a shot properly
another slower one outside off, Faulkner swipes and is beaten again
banged in short and wide outside off stump, gets quite high on Faulkner who bails out of the shot and then looks at the umpire to see if it's being called a wide
slow ball wide outside off stump, Faulkner swings and misses
another short ball, another pull, but the ball flies off the top edge over the keeper's head for another boundary
too short and Faulkner uses the long handle to pull the ball hard towards cow corner, the fielder in the deep runs to his right to field but fails to make a clean stop
Samson moves forward and across and clips a full ball through midwicket
tries to nudge the ball off the pads but fails to make proper contact, the Royals challenge is sputtering
short ball and Faulkner pulls it with a flat bat towards long on
played off the pads through midwicket for one more
flicked off the pads through midwicket

Bopara's done it for Royals and look at that nonchalant nod from the bowler as his team-mates rush towards him in glee! Smith went deep into his crease to try and cut the ball, the length was a bit full and the line was too straight. He missed and Bopara hit. Is that the game?
too short, and Smith waits on the back foot and bides his time before slamming the ball through midwicket to the boundary
driven down the ground for a single

that's a shot worthy of admiration. Smith stayed in his crease, made a bit of room by moving his front leg towards the leg side and then drove with a perfectly straight bat, Warner was at long off and he's really quick but he had no chance even though the ball was not far from him
flicked off the pads towards the leg side, he did not time that well
Smith steps out to make the length a full one and then drives the ball firmly along the ground to deep cover
pulled hard but along the ground and straight to the fielder at deep square
they have got two here, dabbing a really slow delivery gently into the space at midwicket and running the second before the fielders from the deep can come rushing in
cut hard off the back foot but straight to the man at point

another tremendous blow! He skips out of his crease a long way to get right to the pitch of the ball and then unfurls a mighty, unrestrained swing, that's arrow straight again over the sightscreen and much bigger than the previous one
dabbed close on the leg side for a single
Faulkner is caught on the back foot by one that slides into him as he tries to defend, that was missing leg
steps out of his crease again and flicks the ball through square

that is dead straight, and a huge six. Smith charges the bowler to get to the pitch of the ball and creates enough space by moving outside leg to cart the ball over the sightscreen, passes 50 off 32 balls
Ishant delivers another full toss, Faulkner goes deep into his crease and pulls again, smacking it far over the deep  midwicket boundary
short ball and Smith heaves it to deep midwicket, along the ground but not in the gap
a full ball nearly in the blockhole on off and middle, dug out towards long on
a friendly full toss, Faulkner gets low and swats it over the deep square leg boundary, he's hit that miles on to the roof, admittedly it is a low stand there ... they need a new ball
strays on to the pads again, Smith glances but Ojha dives full length to his left to make the save
a full toss at thigh height on the pads, flicked from the crease through square leg

caught in the deep! Hooda slogs at one outside off stump and mis-hits it towards wide long-off, about 2/3rds of the way in from the boundary, fielders from deep cover and long off run towards the ball, but Bhuvneshwar has made good ground from the straight boundary and he catches it at head height. He nearly over ran it
nudged into the covers, Hooda tries to get off strike but can't
steps out of his crease but Hooda isn't to the pitch of the ball, he half defend, half pads the ball away
steps out of his crease this time and clubs the ball towards long on
top placement and timing from Smith, he goes deep into his crease, waits for the ball and cuts late through the gap between two fielders at backward point
skips out of his crease and towards the off side to whip the ball through midwicket
Smith walks far outside the off stump and flicks the ball through square
a full ball on middle and leg, Smith nudges it gently towards mid-on, Ishant has to run a long way in from long-on and he isn't the quickest so can't prevent the second
short ball, never mind if it is slow, Smith winds up and pulls, hitting the ball into the gap on the square leg boundary
another slower ball outside off, Smith gets beaten on the cut, the ball bounces a second time before reaching the keeper
slower ball from Henriques but Smith is good enough to move across his stumps early, he then waits for the ball and hits it to the square leg boundary with perfect timing
Smith charges the bowler and then lunges, using every inch of his reach to slap a short of a length and wide delivery to the cover boundary
again no pace to work with, Hooda tries to cut the ball but tries to hit it too hard, he mis-times towards point
Smith steps out and chips towards square leg
that was measured at 96 kph, Bopara really slowing it down, the batsman works it to point
reaches for the ball outside off to drive to cover but gets an inside edge towards the leg side, Royals have huffed and puffed to 50
really slow from Bopara on off stump, driven to long on for a single
good length, wicket to wicket line, played back to the bowler
worked off the pads through square leg for a single, Hooda has his first run
Hooda wafts at one outside off and is beaten by a short of a length delivery that moves away from him
worked off the pads through midwicket for a single

Nair hasn't gone anywhere in this innings and the stagnation has got to him. He charged the bowler and slogged across the line, the delivery was on a good length and pretty straight, the ball flew straight up in the air and Ojha settled under the skier
that's too wide outside off stump, the batsman has a mighty heave at it and is beaten
a full ball on middle and off, a touch slower, played from the crease to long on
width offered outside off stump by Henriques, cuts off the back foot through point for a single
goes back to cut but gets a bottom edge into the ground, that was really close to the stumps
the batsman seemed to premeditate the sweep, getting outside the line of off stump and paddling, the impact on the pad was outside off stump
steps out of his crease to get to the pitch of the ball and hits through midwicket
gets down on one knee and sweeps behind square
Nair's away with a fluent front foot drive through cover, Smith pushes hard for the second run
steps out of his crease and drives to long on
short of a length and wide outside off, cut firmly off the back foot but can't beat point
dabbed off the front foot towards point, Nair on zero after four balls
a fuller ball around off stump, Nair moves forward gracefully and punches towards cover, but he can't find the gap
good length on off and middle, Nair stays in his crease, gets behind the line and defends
this time Smith moves towards the off side, moving right across his stumps to flick the ball from off stump through square leg
jumps out of his crease and outside leg to hit through the off side, Ishant follows him so Smith can only play it to point
defended on the off side

dropped at deep square leg! Smith stepped out of his crease and flicked an inswinger off his pads, lofting it high towards Henriques, the fielder ran to his right and dived, he got hands to it but spilled it

this is some good bowling, Praveen gets the ball to angle into the right-hander and then straighten off the surface after a couple of big inswingers, Smith pushes forward and gets an outside edge that runs wide of the keeper for four
Smith mis-hits the ball towards midwicket
a louder appeal for lbw but the umpire says not out. Smith moves right across his stumps to flick through square but gets hit on the pad by a sharp inswinger, that was a bit too high
turns the ball off his pads, or tries to at least, he didn't make contact and there's half an lbw appeal
caught at mid-on, Ishant has got rid of Watson! A tame dismissal that was. Watson tried to loft a good length ball over the fielder's head at mid-on but could not clear Praveen Kumar
played off the front foot on the off side

Smith jumps forward and towards leg to create room to hit inside out on the off side, Ishant follows him a touch and denies him space to free his arms, Smith adjusts and pushes the ball towards cover point
another half volley, outside off stump this time, Smith strides forward to meet the ball and drives it on the up through cover. Masterful.
played back to the bowler

oh dear, Ishant falls over in his follow through as he delivers a half-volley, he watches from the ground as the ball races past him and mid-off to the boundary, Smith hit that with a punch off the front foot
cut hard off the back foot towards point
played into the off side
full and wide outside off, Watson lunges for it and slashes, getting a thick edge that sends the ball flying his wide of the diving fielder at first slip, he hit that with the bottom of his bat
short of a length with width outside off, Watson stays back and cuts hard into the ground, sending the ball bouncing over the infield at point and to the boundary

what happened there? Smith hoicked at a good length ball and mis-hit it over the bowler's head. Both mid-on and mid-off converged on the catch but no one went 100% after it in the end. Surely that was Warner's catch from mid-off?
gets behind he line of a good length ball pitching outside off and nipping into the righthander, late movement and Smith counters it with a straight bat towards the bowler
Watson tries to work the ball off his hips towards square but is beaten by the sharp movement into him from outside off and gets hit on the thigh
Praveen starts around off, swings it into the right-hander, and then gets it to straighten too, wibbly wobbly. Watson gets a bit squared up in his crease as he plays to mid on
poor line, Praveen swings the ball on to the pads, Watson flicks and makes clean contact, sending the ball to the square leg boundary
flicked off the pads, but doesn't make proper contact, the ball goes to midwicket
Watson tries to cut but has no room again, gets a bottom edge into the pitch and towards the keeper's left, Ojha does well to move nimbly and save runs
swings the ball into the right-hander, quite a bit of movement, cramps Watson for room. He gets an inside edge on to the pad as he tries to push on the off side

caught behind! That is a top catch from Ojha, diving across first slip with his right arm outstretched to take the ball. Rahane had pushed forward at a good length ball that pitched around off and shaped away, getting a thick edge. After two wide balls in the over, this one was on a much better line.
shot! A half-volley outside off stump and Rahane plays the perfect cover drive, hitting it so hard to the boundary

he's lucky there! Rahane moved forward and closed the face too early, he was trying to play towards square leg. the ball flew off the leading edge but fell safely at cover point. There were three fielders in the region
there's no one in the way there! Short and wide outside off, Rahane stays back and frees his arms, smashing the ball through cover with a forceful drive
shorter in length and wider in line, Rahane plays a fluent square drive off the back foot but the fielder at point is in the way
good length with a hint of movement away from the right-hand batsman, Rahane stays in his crease and defends on the off side
